data.name: Serapid Corrosion - raised sept 2022
data.notes:
Raised in https://app.asana.com/0/1201174618766887/1203718333414899/f

Feedback from Kelvin: 
The chains aren’t specifically finished for ‘outdoor’ use as such but a ‘covered’ installation such as yours should be OK with regular inspection and a squirt of oil – any corrosio0n to the chain links and/or sprocket is only likely to be surface based and should clean off with a small wire brush or wire wool – if the rust is bad enough to stop the links from pivoting, then this probably means it has been exposed or submerged for long periods without moving.
It’s also possible that there could be some ingress of debris into the magazine that is affecting the smooth operation of the chain.
